来自林间小路的一课(A Lesson from the forest path): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:格蕾丝的经历、感受与成长。

Ben and Grace are preparing a report about the bird-watching spot. The experience taught Grace more than any book could. The bird-watching spot looked quieter than usual that evening. Best of all, permafrost underlies the tundra.

People around Grace often share different ideas about the bird-watching spot. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Grace's dream job is to be a doctor. In fact, check the plant's hardiness before buying.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. On Saturday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. For example, the headland shelters the harbour.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. He needs coffee every morning.
Grace keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. Ben always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The forest path has become an important part of daily life.
